coordinate_convention: Original-source pixels, top-left origin; rect x,y,w,h is half-open [x,x+w) × [y,y+h). Broad windows may overlap and include neighboring art/transparent pixels.

inspection.scale: 1/4 overview, 1/2 overlapping 1024px height bands spaced896px, 2x/3x pilot detail crops

coverage.denominator: Nonzero source-alpha pixels, not assets; includes lettering/shadows. Whole sheet visually examined, zero objects claimed fully segmented.

regions.name: Terrain, fences, small park vegetation
regions.evidence: Surface swatches, tree/shrub samples, benches and fences; street assets overlap on left.

regions.name: Domestic garden, villa and tree-house kit

regions.name: Tree color and form banks

regions.name: Street props and construction equipment
regions.evidence: Traffic/street props, work barriers, scaffolding and construction materials.

regions.evidence: Window/roof palettes and repeated storefronts with signage.
